parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this token. It must be unique across requests, case-sensitive, and up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: DBDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the database. The description must meet the following requirements:

- It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- It must be 2 to 256 characters in length.
